steps.title: Overlay Action service: port parseCommand/resolveSelector/approvePlan/executePlan into a real, callable service
steps.task: Create services/overlay-action-service.js exporting parseCommand, resolveSelector, approvePlan, and executePlan -- a deterministic port of the already-proven prototype scripts/prototype-overlay-action-v4.mjs (10/10 tests), EXCLUDING runOverlayAction (which launches its own browser -- out of scope per founder packet). No AI/model call anywhere in this file. Do not include the prototype's self-test auto-execution code, dotenv/assert/fs/path imports (unused once runOverlayAction is excluded), or the `let puppeteer;` module-level variable (also unused).

args_list: Fill the full name with Alice Smith and stop before submitting

non_goals: launching or managing a browser session -- executePlan takes an already-connected page
any AI/model call -- this must remain deterministic like the proven prototype
wiring into services/browser-agent.js or any live product surface (deferred)
redesigning the risky-action list or approval policy shape
